culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Carry your original passport; police do not always accept copies. Dress modestly at religious places. Do not photograph military sites, government buildings, radio and TV stations, the Presidency or Abidjan Airport. Attitudes to LGBT+ people are less tolerant and partnerships are not recognised.
culture-and-protocol.note: From UK Government (FCDO) travel advice, written for British travellers but the laws apply to all visitors. Confirm locally.
